entries.clue: Standing storm you step into before work
Warm damp stuffiness left hanging after a long hot soak
Water-banking plant of dry regions, its leaves fat and its skin waxy
Blue-robed Berber people of the central wastes, whose men cover their faces
What a monk wears daily and a bather wears briefly
Fleshy spined plant hoarding water in a swollen stem
Latin service for the dead; Britten set a wartime one against Owen's poems
Quietly frightening in the way an empty corridor can be.
Doom spoken over someone, said to follow their line for generations.
The polite bit at the end of brushing, aimed at the bowl
Feather-fronded tree whose bunched fruit is dried and sold as dates
Filmy white emanation of the darkened seance room, often exposed as cheesecloth.
